title: Fake Lag Tool READ DESC
features:
this is a tool to fake lag
once clicking on your screen using the tool, you will turn into a ghost
the ghost cant be seen, but your actual character can be seen
click the tool again while being a ghost to teleport your character to where the ghost is. (you will return back to normal too obviously)
WARNING: you have to rejoin incase if someone (somehow) flings your ghost, because when it gets deleted by the void you wont recover.
